unit_tests.validation: Strict RPC adapter doubles; native UTXO/script validity is exercised by separate functional tests.

limitations: Activation-height policy is explicit and must match the native node; default activation1 leaves old v4 journal configuration unchanged.
Receipt historical lookups are bounded to64 snapshots/64MiB per page; missing/over-budget history reports unknown.
The local ACK is provisional until canonical admission. Confirmed credit can remain pending until its pool produces a settling block.
The binaries recorded here precede the separate pending-block duplicate-download optimization; report per-run hash must be preserved.
